pages.notes: Official memorandum with handwritten routing/approval marks; OCR captured body text well but misread 'is' as '7S' in one instance and text is cut off at page bottom.
Typewritten government document with aged paper and OFFICIAL USE ONLY classification marks; OCR captured nearly all body text accurately despite yellowing and minor paper spots.

Typewritten page with OFFICIAL USE ONLY stamps; OCR captured main text well but misread stamp as 'OFFICTAE=USE*ONLY' and had word errors ('gasses'/'eminating' instead of 'gases'/'emanating'); occasional line-break hyphens and a stray tilde in 're-~adjustment'.

Declassified government document with OFFICIAL USE ONLY stamps; OCR captures 95% of text accurately but contains errors including 'other~side-of-the-moon' (tilde should be hyphen) and phantom text 'PPTUIF' at end not visible in image.

Main body text captured accurately, but OCR mangled the classification stamp headers ('OFFICTAL-USE-ONL' for 'OFFICIAL USE ONLY') and page number ('6 Bee' for '- 5 -'), with incomplete footer rendering.

Body text captured accurately; handwritten signature completely garbled as 'Yop le fla zz' instead of being recognized as cursive writing, and page number formatted as '= 6=' instead of '- 6 -'; Roman numeral II misread as IL.
